prerequisites: Advanced knowledge in programming, OOAD and modeling.

learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed this module will have a sound understanding of how to manage the complexity of technical computing systems.
Students who have successfully completed this module critically examine different systems.
Students who have successfully completed this module represent systems through model-like mappings using standardized description languages.
Students who have successfully completed this module communicate complex technical computing systems in a well-structured and coherent manner.
Students who have successfully completed this module apply methods, techniques, and tools of Systems Engineering professionally.

assessment_rules: The graded assessment can be a written project report (approx. 8-12 pages with a 10-minute explanation) or an exam (according to the current study regulations). The ungraded assessment is experimental work, consisting of approximately 10 experiments in total.
